# Canadian Equality Consulting

> Canadian Equality Consulting is a DEI consulting firm specializing in workplace culture transformation, inclusive leadership training, and organizational equity solutions across Canada.

Canadian Equality Consulting (CEC) provides comprehensive diversity, equity, and inclusion services including Culture 360 subscription training, GBA Plus analysis, leadership certification, and culture consulting. The firm serves organizations seeking to build genuinely inclusive workplaces through evidence-based consulting and professional development programs.

## Key Topics

- Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI)
- Workplace Culture
- Inclusive Leadership
- Culture 360
- GBA Plus (Gender-Based Analysis Plus)
- DEI Training
- Organizational Culture
- HR Consulting
- Organizational Development
- Professional Development
- Workplace Inclusion
- Organizational Assessment
- Consulting Services
- Canadian Consultancy
- Performative Inclusion

- [DEI Implementation Consultant for Inclusion Policy & Change](https://canadianequality.ca/services/implementation): DEI implementation consulting for policy and culture change
- [GBA Plus Services for Inclusive Diversity Planning](https://canadianequality.ca/services/gba): Gender-Based Analysis Plus services and certification
